titulo_es: Percentages and limits of a survey
intro: A figure describes only the population, question and period measured; it reviews no response, sample size and selection mode.

bloques.titulo: A figure describes only the population, question and period measured; it reviews no response, sample size and selection mode.
texto: A figure describes only the population, question and period measured; it reviews no response, sample size and selection mode.
Percentages can add up to more than 100 if several responses are allowed; check the methodological note.

frases.ru: Опрос показал, что 38 процентов участников читают новости в приложении.
frases.es: La encuesta mostró que el 38 % de los participantes lee noticias en una aplicación.
frases.en: The survey showed that 38% of participants read news in an application.

frases.ru: Респондентам разрешили выбрать несколько вариантов, поэтому доли нельзя складывать как взаимоисключающие.
frases.es: Se permitió elegir varias opciones, así que las proporciones no pueden sumarse como si fueran excluyentes.
frases.en: Several options were allowed, so the proportions cannot be added as if they were exclusive.
